title: US equity markets close early at 1:00 p.m. ET — the day after Thanksgiving, and the last session before the December FOMC blackout opens
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this lane (HTTP 200 after its 302 — the page needs curl -L — 109,148 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell this session. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its Thanksgiving Day row gives 'Thursday, November 25***' for 2027, and footnote *** reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' The 2027 date is therefore READ, not derived — the page names it explicitly. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the FOURTH Thursday in November, the fourth Thursday of November 2027 is 2027-11-25, and the day after is Friday 2027-11-26. Filed estimate on the same count thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 and good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 documented: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange operator's own hours page, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. BOND SIDE NOT CLAIMED: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule was fetched successfully the same session (HTTP 200, 298,899 bytes) but its rendered markup carries only the 2026 panel; the 2027 tab's contents are not in the fetched HTML, so no SIFMA recommendation for 2027-11-26 is asserted here. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08). It reuses the schema precedent thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 set exactly — kind 'sector', impact low, symbols [], estimate with a NEWS: source — and invents no new kind. WHY THIS PARTICULAR HALF DAY EARNS A ROW rather than being one more holiday: it is the DEADLINE SESSION of the December 2027 FOMC blackout. The gate opens 12:00 a.m. ET Saturday 2027-11-27, so 2027-11-26 is the last session on which any FOMC participant may make on-record monetary-policy remarks before the year's final meeting — and it is a three-and-a-half-hour session. Measured across the 167-meeting FOMC census this lane parsed from federalreserve.gov (2007-2027), only 4 of 167 gates have a deadline session that is an NYSE early close, and three of them are consecutive: 2025, 2026, 2027, against one earlier instance in 2019. THIN IS NOT THE SAME AS SAFE, and that is the reason this is on the board rather than in a footnote. Black Friday sessions run 0.702x their own November baseline in the MEDIAN absolute S&P move (12 of 19 below 1.0x, 2007-2025) but 0.958x in the MEAN, because 2021-11-26 — the one Black Friday in the sample on which news actually landed, the omicron session — moved the S&P 2.27% and lifted VIX 10.04 points, the 99.6th percentile of all 5,203 daily VIX moves 2006-2026. A half session with holiday liquidity amplifies whatever reaches it. CONSEQUENCE RECORDED, NOT TRADED: no US tape reaction should be read off 2027-11-26 as though it were a full session, and this lane's own stance treats the deadline as uninformative in the median and dangerous in the tail. Impact is LOW and symbols is empty: this is a market-structure fact that changes how other events are READ, not an event with its own directional content. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
